messages:
olivia_sales: New POC ask from FinLedger: They operate in both UK and EU and want data to remain in the customer's preferred jurisdiction during the POC. They want a short note on how we handle UK vs EU routing and subprocessors. Also asked if we can pin to a region and provide a CSV of subprocessors.

deepak_presales: TL;DR: We can do region affinity per tenant. For UK customers we can pin to eu-west-2 (London) and for EU to eu-west-1 (Ireland) but note hosted monitoring/logging vendors sometimes centralize telemetry. Dedicated/Private would be the contractual guarantee.

hannah_security: We can provide subprocessors export and a short attestation. Important: if they require UK-only contractual processing we'll need legal to add jurisdictional clauses; BYOK preferred for key custody. Also flag differences in standard contractual clauses for UK.

ben_ops: Ops note: we can create two pinned tenants for the POC (one in London, one in Dublin) and route by tenant tag. If they want strict no-cross-border, reserve capacity to avoid cross-region fallback and use EU/UK-only telemetry endpoints. Short-term Dedicated pool is an option.

deploy_bot: export ready: s3://exports/finledger_poc/subprocessors_2026-03-26.csv

olivia_sales: perfect — I'll attach that and ask whether they prefer Hosted-affinity or need Dedicated for hard guarantee. Also asking whether they accept combined attestation or separate UK/EU attestation.

hannah_security: recommend separate attestation per jurisdiction to match local SCC/KnownDataProcessing terms. legal will need to review if they ask for contractual UK-only clause.

deepak_presales: include a scoping sentence for the customer: "We will process and store POC data in the customer's chosen jurisdiction (UK or EU). Hosted affinity pins to the selected region; Dedicated or Private deployments are required for a contractual, no-cross-border guarantee. We will provide a subprocessors list and jurisdiction-specific attestations for the POC period."

olivia_sales: thanks — I'll send that and price uplift ballpark later. ETA EOD for initial reply.

ben_ops: ballpark Dedicated uplift for a 21-day POC ~25% over hosted, depends on GPU profile. include minimum monthly commit unless Private option chosen.
